payload.title: Inventory Hyperframes catalog coverage and existing Babulus equivalents
payload.description:
## Behavior
As a maintainer, I can see which Hyperframes effects have VideoML equivalents and which remain to be built.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given a pinned Hyperframes revision, when its blocks/components/shaders are inventoried, then every entry has a stable upstream identity, category, provenance, dependency, VideoML mapping, and explicit status (planned, implemented, verified, or deferred with reason).
Given an existing Babulus demo, when matched, then reuse or migration is assessed before rebuilding. Full coverage is the target; no claim of parity from a sample alone.

## Ownership
toolchain, specification, player, stdlib; consult Babulus

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
